title: RCMP in the parade of dignitaries
description: During the parade of dignitaries, RCMP members showcased the evolution of their uniforms, beginning with the white helmet worn at Queen Victoria’s Jubilee in 1897 through to the broad-brimmed Stetson hat, the transition from close-fitting yellow-striped blue breeches to jodhpurs, and various changes in belts, boots, gloves, and other accessories.
